G03.summary: Verified against the Nix build of the tree at 35c13d5d8 (named in prose: the gate requires null commit fields until publication, and a commit field is a claim about status rather than a note about which tree was inspected). Verified locally and deterministically; needs no authorization, which is why it is resolved rather than deferred with G02/G05. Split the node before running it: the protocol behaviors it names (pair, subscribe, history, send/cancel, disconnect/reconnect/resync, stale-ack) are ALREADY covered end to end over a real loopback socket by gateway_e2e_pair_ws_history_send_cancel_reconnect_and_stale_ack_isolation plus ~20 focused tests in crates/jcode-base/src/gateway_tests.rs. Re-driving those from bash would have been a worse copy of a better test. The genuinely unproven part is the packaging seam, which no cargo test can reach because a cargo test always runs inside a checkout where the developer CWD fallback masks a broken install. scripts/verify_g03_browser_surface.sh runs the Nix-built binary from a non-checkout temp dir and checks packaged layout, byte-identical assets (cmp, not just HTTP 200, since a 200 could be an error page), and refused path traversal. ALL PASS. The decisive check is a control: a decoy web/jcode-mobile planted in CWD must not be served. I falsified the control instead of trusting its green, by pointing JCODE_MOBILE_WEB_ROOT at the decoy and confirming the same binary then DOES serve it. It can go red, so the pass is meaningful. Infrastructure finding recorded, not a product defect: two Nix builds died with 'daemon disconnected' and a third hung 84 minutes with zero rustc on either machine and the remote daemon at 0% CPU. That is a stall, not slowness; --builders '' finished in under 90 seconds, locating the fault in the remote builder path.

CORRECTIONS to this node's previous summary, which was wrong in two ways. (1) It said (b) was still live with 27 inline predicates; the true count of hand-rolled TERMINAL SETS was 11, in commands_improve.rs, remote/key_handling.rs and ui_messages.rs, all now routed through is_terminal_todo_status. (2) It listed (d)+(e) as the remaining correctness risk but did not name the trap: filtering blocked items out of the incomplete partition empties it, and an empty partition falls into settle_completed_todo_list and announces 'Todos complete' over unfinished work. Verified, not assumed: the naive one-line filter flipped gate4 part 2 from ok to FAILED. Blocked is therefore a third PokeDisposition state, not a suppression. Gate 3 already held on shipped code; evidence was added at finish_turn rather than a fix. Also removed rather than budgeted: poke_todos' unwrap_or_default, since a failed read read as a finished list and announced completion. Stays 'implemented' rather than 'accepted' because the work is unmerged; the railway gate rejects a published_commit that is not an ancestor of main. Closes on PR #90 merge.
